title: Black Light FTL Installation Archaeology and Compartment Evidence Registry

authority.scope: DERIVED installation-archaeology authority constrained by CONFIRMED propulsion-family physics, forensic-identification rules, and named vessel/species evidence. It converts physical spaces and surviving installation evidence into provenance-safe observations without preselecting a transit family.
sourceOrder: Google Drive: The different lightspeed methods

principles: A room name is a conclusion, not an observation. Record geometry, connections, residues, machinery, damage, and surviving data before assigning function.
Installation topology is evidence: power, cooling, nutrient, structural, data, timing, field, and maintenance connections constrain what machinery could have done.

Damage modifies detectability and can create misleading analogues. A missing expected component is not a contradiction unless the relevant volume and evidence channel survived well enough to reveal it.
Inaccessible volumes remain explicit unknowns. The generator may not fill them with the component needed to rescue a preferred hypothesis.
Repeated displays derived from one sensor or archive ancestor remain one provenance lineage.
Reversible passive observations outrank destructive inspection when both can answer the same question.
Function labels promote only when independent evidence supports the physical role. Family labels require the separate forensic resolver's standards.

compartmentModel.installationGraphRule: Model a suspected transit installation as a multiplex graph G_I=(V,E_1...E_n). Different edge layers must not be collapsed into generic adjacency because field, power, structural, timing, and cooling topology carry different diagnostic meaning.
compartmentModel.unknownVolumeRule: A sealed, destroyed, blocked, or unlocated volume may hold unknown components, but no generated component inside it may be treated as observed evidence. It contributes uncertainty, not support.

evidenceLifecycle.promotionRule: An observation may be promoted to FUNCTION_INTERPRETED only when geometry or behavior plus at least one independent service/dependency, residue, telemetry, or load-path lineage supports the proposed role.
evidenceLifecycle.contaminationRule: Opening, energizing, moving, cutting, flushing, healing, regrowing, or reconfiguring alien machinery can change residues and geometry. Pre-intervention state must be captured before mutation and later observations must identify the intervention ancestor.
evidenceLifecycle.destructiveTestRule: Destructive inspection is admissible only when lower-hazard methods cannot answer a materially important question and the expected information gain justifies loss of future evidence.

mathematics.compartmentEvidenceWeight: W_c = R_c * D_c * P_c * S_c, where R is observation reliability, D is damage-adjusted detectability, P is provenance independence, and S is spatial specificity in [0,1].
mathematics.dependencyCentrality: C_d(v) = sum_l alpha_l * C_l(v), where C_l is centrality in a service layer such as power, timing, field, thermal, structural, or data. Coefficients are DERIVED and scenario-specific.
mathematics.geometryConsistency: G_f = exp(-0.5 * delta_g^T Sigma_g^-1 delta_g), a DERIVED fit measure between observed installation geometry and the family-conditioned geometry predicted by confirmed operator physics. It is a ranking aid, not canon probability.
mathematics.damageAdjustedAbsence: A^-_m = I_m * V_m * S_m * (1-D_m), where instrument capability I, observed-volume coverage V, expected marker survivability S, and destructive damage fraction D determine whether absence is meaningful.
mathematics.informationGain: U_T = IG(T) / (1 + lambda_h H_T + lambda_d D_T + lambda_c C_T), balancing expected family/function information gain against hazard, evidence destruction, and contamination.
mathematics.familyEvidenceExport: E_export = {channel, observation, reliability, detectability, provenanceGroup, spatialRef, damageContext, familyLikelihoodVector, contradictions}. Family promotion remains the responsibility of resolveTransitForensics().

inspectionProgram.name: Pre-Entry Exterior and Residual Survey
inspectionProgram.purpose: Capture external geometry, hull discontinuities, field residues, thermal state, structural scars, and possible external apertures before internal intervention.

inspectionProgram.name: Compartment Geometry Census
inspectionProgram.purpose: Assign neutral compartment IDs, measure dimensions, interfaces, equipment distribution, inaccessible boundaries, and whole-vessel spatial relationships without assuming room function.

inspectionProgram.name: Multiplex Dependency Mapping
inspectionProgram.purpose: Trace power, cooling, nutrient, timing, data, field, structural, and maintenance routes to identify installation-scale clusters and independent recovery reserves.

inspectionProgram.name: Residue and Damage Stratigraphy
inspectionProgram.purpose: Separate operating residues, accident products, post-accident decay, later repairs, biological regrowth, and investigator contamination.

inspectionProgram.name: Archive and Telemetry Ancestry Recovery
inspectionProgram.purpose: Recover route, maintenance, timing, control, alarm, and configuration records while preserving source ancestry and translation uncertainty.

inspectionProgram.name: Functional Hypothesis Review
inspectionProgram.purpose: Assign bounded machinery-role hypotheses only after geometry and dependency evidence support them; export operator-level observations to the family forensic resolver.

inspectionProgram.name: Low-Authority Reversible Excitation
inspectionProgram.purpose: Stimulate isolated components below commit-capable authority to measure response where passive evidence is insufficient.

inspectionProgram.name: Post-Intervention Recertification
inspectionProgram.purpose: Re-measure geometry and dependencies after cutting, repair, biological healing, regrowth, relocation, or energization so altered evidence is never mistaken for original state.

knownInstallationFacts: The vessel is an unidentified damaged Ar'nock vessel in deep space.
It contains biological printers, medical systems, cultivated computation, environmental controls, storage, fabrication feedstock, damaged networks, and inaccessible compartments.
Architecture reflects nonhuman ergonomic and sensory assumptions while remaining navigable by human-scale occupants.
The vessel lacks an immediately readable name, registry, destination, or complete surviving historical explanation.
Biological construction and cultivated computation do not identify an FTL family.
Inaccessible compartments are confirmed to exist but their contents are unresolved.
prioritySurveyProgram: Freeze a neutral compartment numbering scheme before naming suspected propulsion spaces.
Build a whole-vessel map of high-capacity power, thermal, nutrient, data, timing, field, and structural routes.
Identify compartments with unusually high multiplex dependency centrality, isolated reserves, or whole-hull field connections.
Record pre-entry residues and damage state around every inaccessible propulsion-scale volume before breaching it.
Recover maintenance and route telemetry with provenance ancestry before attempting translation-driven functional naming.
Export only operator-level discriminators into resolveTransitForensics(); retain the family as UNRESOLVED until its promotion rule is met.
prohibitedShortcuts: Do not call a room a Fold chamber, gate room, phase core, manifold bay, slipstream coupler, or lattice vault from appearance alone.
Do not place the preferred missing component inside an inaccessible compartment as if it were observed.
Do not use biological architecture as evidence for any specific transit family.
Do not treat Q-MAP presence as evidence for Quantum Phase Displacement.
Do not interpret post-investigation regrowth or reconfiguration as original geometry without a pre-intervention comparison.

canonGuards: A compartment label generated by this layer is not historical canon unless a named source independently establishes it.
Do not assign the Ar'nock derelict an FTL family from biological machinery, room shape, annular structures, cultivated computation, or visual resemblance.
Do not count inaccessible volume as positive evidence for any family.
Do not treat absence as contradiction unless instrument capability, observed-volume coverage, marker survivability, and damage state support detectability.
Do not count multiple displays, translations, or derived records from one source ancestor as independent evidence.
Do not erase investigation contamination; every intervention capable of altering evidence must remain in provenance.
Do not treat repaired or regrown biological machinery as geometrically identical to its pre-damage state without measurement.
Do not energize unknown machinery to commit-capable authority solely to improve classification.
Do not invent manufacturer, inventor, date, range, speed, Path level, T-tier, or original mission from installation archaeology.
Do not equate Q-MAP with Quantum Phase Displacement without a higher-authority source.
Do not collapse power, timing, field, thermal, structural, and data topology into one generic connection graph.
Do not promote a functional machinery hypothesis to family identification; export evidence to the forensic resolver instead.
Preserve contradictions and unresolved alternatives rather than averaging them away.
Higher-authority named vessel or installation canon overrides this derived model within its scope.
